janetraylib

raylib 5.5 for Janet: generated bindings, guarded resources, plain data

v0.1.0 quick reference card: raylib · raymath · rlgl

module: rcore →

# Window-related functions


(init-window width height title)                                        # Initialize window and OpenGL context


(close-window)                                                          # Close window and unload OpenGL context


(window-should-close) → bool                                            # Check if application should close (KEY_ESCAPE pressed or windows close icon clicked)


(window-ready?) → bool                                                  # Check if window has been initialized successfully


(window-fullscreen?) → bool                                             # Check if window is currently fullscreen


(window-hidden?) → bool                                                 # Check if window is currently hidden


(window-minimized?) → bool                                              # Check if window is currently minimized


(window-maximized?) → bool                                              # Check if window is currently maximized


(window-focused?) → bool                                                # Check if window is currently focused


(window-resized?) → bool                                                # Check if window has been resized last frame


(window-state? flag) → bool                                             # Check if one specific window flag is enabled


(set-window-state flags)                                                # Set window configuration state using flags


(clear-window-state flags)                                              # Clear window configuration state flags


(toggle-fullscreen)                                                     # Toggle window state: fullscreen/windowed, resizes monitor to match window resolution


(toggle-borderless-windowed)                                            # Toggle window state: borderless windowed, resizes window to match monitor resolution


(maximize-window)                                                       # Set window state: maximized, if resizable


(minimize-window)                                                       # Set window state: minimized, if resizable


(restore-window)                                                        # Set window state: not minimized/maximized


(set-window-icon image)                                                 # Set icon for window (single image, RGBA 32bit)


(set-window-icons images)                                               # Set icon for window (multiple images, RGBA 32bit)


(set-window-title title)                                                # Set title for window


(set-window-position x y)                                               # Set window position on screen


(set-window-monitor monitor)                                            # Set monitor for the current window


(set-window-min-size width height)                                      # Set window minimum dimensions (for FLAG_WINDOW_RESIZABLE)


(set-window-max-size width height)                                      # Set window maximum dimensions (for FLAG_WINDOW_RESIZABLE)


(set-window-size width height)                                          # Set window dimensions


(set-window-opacity opacity)                                            # Set window opacity [0.0f..1.0f]


(set-window-focused)                                                    # Set window focused


(get-window-handle) → pointer                                           # Get native window handle


(get-screen-width) → number                                             # Get current screen width


(get-screen-height) → number                                            # Get current screen height


(get-render-width) → number                                             # Get current render width (it considers HiDPI)


(get-render-height) → number                                            # Get current render height (it considers HiDPI)


(get-monitor-count) → number                                            # Get number of connected monitors


(get-current-monitor) → number                                          # Get current monitor where window is placed


(get-monitor-position monitor) → [x y]                                  # Get specified monitor position


(get-monitor-width monitor) → number                                    # Get specified monitor width (current video mode used by monitor)


(get-monitor-height monitor) → number                                   # Get specified monitor height (current video mode used by monitor)


(get-monitor-physical-width monitor) → number                           # Get specified monitor physical width in millimetres


(get-monitor-physical-height monitor) → number                          # Get specified monitor physical height in millimetres


(get-monitor-refresh-rate monitor) → number                             # Get specified monitor refresh rate


(get-window-position) → [x y]                                           # Get window position XY on monitor


(get-window-scale-dpi) → [x y]                                          # Get window scale DPI factor


(get-monitor-name monitor) → string                                     # Get the human-readable, UTF-8 encoded name of the specified monitor


(set-clipboard-text text)                                               # Set clipboard text content


(get-clipboard-text) → string                                           # Get clipboard text content


(get-clipboard-image) → Image                                           # Get clipboard image content


(enable-event-waiting)                                                  # Enable waiting for events on EndDrawing(), no automatic event polling


(disable-event-waiting)                                                 # Disable waiting for events on EndDrawing(), automatic events polling

# Set custom callbacks


(set-trace-log-callback)                                                # excluded: raylib also logs from its audio thread, where Janet cannot run; use set-trace-log-capture and take-trace-logs


(set-load-file-data-callback)                                           # excluded: C file-IO hook; use Janet file functions instead


(set-save-file-data-callback)                                           # excluded: C file-IO hook; use Janet file functions instead


(set-load-file-text-callback)                                           # excluded: C file-IO hook; use Janet file functions instead


(set-save-file-text-callback)                                           # excluded: C file-IO hook; use Janet file functions instead




# Files management functions


(load-file-data file-name) → buffer                                     # Load file data as byte array (read)


(unload-file-data)                                                      # excluded: freed by the binding when load-file-data returns


(save-file-data file-name data) → bool                                  # Save data to file from byte array (write), returns true on success


(export-data-as-code data file-name) → bool                             # Export data to code (.h), returns true on success


(load-file-text file-name) → string                                     # Load text data from file (read), returns a '\0' terminated string


(unload-file-text)                                                      # excluded: freed by the binding when load-file-text returns


(save-file-text file-name text) → bool                                  # Save text data to file (write), string must be '\0' terminated, returns true on success

(load-dropped-files) → FilePathList                                     # Load dropped filepaths

(get-file-mod-time file-name) → number                                  # Get file modification time (last write time)

# Scoped forms (raylib layer); the closing call runs even if body errors


(with-window width height title ...)        # Open a window, run body, and close the window afterwards.


(with-audio-device ...)                     # Initialize the audio device around body.


(with-drawing ...)                          # Run body between begin-drawing and end-drawing.


(with-mode-2d camera ...)                   # Run body inside begin-mode-2d with camera.


(with-mode-3d camera ...)                   # Run body inside begin-mode-3d with camera.


(with-texture-mode target ...)              # Draw body into the render texture target.


(with-shader-mode shader ...)               # Draw body with shader active.


(with-blend-mode mode ...)                  # Draw body with a BlendMode (keyword or integer).


(with-scissor-mode x y width height ...)    # Clip drawing in body to the rectangle x, y, width, height.


(with-vr-stereo-mode config ...)            # Draw body in VR stereo mode with config.


(with-matrix ...)                           # Run body between rl-push-matrix and rl-pop-matrix.




# Resources


(with [x (load-...) unload-...] ...)        # Janet's own with: unload any handle when the body exits


(handle-live? x)                            # True when a raylib handle or array can still be used: it has not been unloaded, and neither has the resource it belongs to.


(unload-model-resources model &opt keep)    # Unload model together with the textures its materials reference, which unload-model leaves behind


(unload-materials materials)                # Unload every material in an array returned by load-materials, then free the array.




# Logging (raylib logs from its audio thread, so no Janet callback)


(set-trace-log-capture enabled)             # When enabled, raylib log messages (from any thread) are queued instead of printed; collect them with take-trace-logs


(take-trace-logs) → @[[level message] ...]  # Remove and return queued log messages, oldest first, as an array of [level message] tuples, where level is a TraceLogLevel integer




# Handle fields


(texture :width)                            # read a field by keyword; (keys handle) lists them


(put model :transform m)                    # write a field; fields that size memory are read-only


(get-in model [:materials 0 :maps 0])       # views into owned memory; they die with their owner

values →

# Values crossing the boundary


(draw-circle-v [x y] r :red)                       # vectors and rectangles are tuples (arrays work too)


(matrix-translate 1 2 3) → [16 numbers]            # matrices are 16 numbers in raylib field order: m0 m4 m8 m12 m1 ... (row-major)


(clear-background [245 245 245])                   # colors: [r g b], [r g b a] with 0-255 integers, or a keyword


(update-camera-pro {:position [0 2 4] ...} m r z)  # plain structs are structs/tables with kebab keys; all fields required


(key-down? :space)                                 # enum parameters take member keywords or integers


(set-config-flags [:vsync-hint :msaa-4x-hint])     # flag enums also take a tuple of keywords (OR-ed)


(check-collision-lines a b c d) → [bool [x y]]     # C out-parameters are returned, after the result


(set camera (update-camera camera :orbital))       # in/out parameters come back updated; rebind them


(draw-line-strip [[0 0] [10 5]] :red)              # array + count parameters take one tuple; the count is implied


(load-file-data "f.bin") → buffer                  # C memory returned by Load* is copied into Janet and freed

structs →

# tuples: [...] of numbers


(Vector2) → [x y]                                                             # Vector2, 2 components


(Vector3) → [x y z]                                                           # Vector3, 3 components


(Vector4) → [x y z w]                                                         # Vector4, 4 components


(Matrix) → [16 numbers]                                                       # Matrix, 4x4 components, column major, OpenGL style, right-handed


(Color) → [r g b a]                                                           # Color, 4 components, R8G8B8A8 (32bit)


(Rectangle) → [x y w h]                                                       # Rectangle, 4 components


(float3) → [3 numbers]                                                        # NOTE: Helper types to be used instead of array return types for *ToFloat functions


(float16) → [16 numbers]                                                      # 




# plain structs: {:key value}, every field required


(NPatchInfo :source :left :top :right :bottom :layout)                        # NPatchInfo, n-patch layout info


(Camera3D :position :target :up :fovy :projection)                            # Camera, defines position/orientation in 3d space


(Camera2D :offset :target :rotation :zoom)                                    # Camera2D, defines position/orientation in 2d space


(Transform :translation :rotation :scale)                                     # Transform, vertex transformation data


(BoneInfo :name :parent)                                                      # Bone, skeletal animation bone


(Ray :position :direction)                                                    # Ray, ray for raycasting


(RayCollision :hit :distance :point :normal)                                  # RayCollision, ray hit information


(BoundingBox :min :max)                                                       # BoundingBox


(VrDeviceInfo :h-resolution :v-resolution :h-screen-size :v-screen-size :eye-to-screen-distance :lens-separation-distance :interpupillary-distance :lens-distortion-values :chroma-ab-correction)  # VrDeviceInfo, Head-Mounted-Display device parameters


(VrStereoConfig :projection :view-offset :left-lens-center :right-lens-center :left-screen-center :right-screen-center :scale :scale-in)  # VrStereoConfig, VR stereo rendering configuration for simulator


(AutomationEvent :frame :type :params)                                        # Automation event




# handles: guarded resources; fields by keyword, * = read-only


(Image :data :width* :height* :mipmaps* :format*)                             # Image, pixel data stored in CPU memory (RAM)


(Texture :id* :width* :height* :mipmaps* :format*)                            # Texture, tex data stored in GPU memory (VRAM)


(RenderTexture :id* :texture :depth)                                          # RenderTexture, fbo for texture rendering


(GlyphInfo :value :offset-x :offset-y :advance-x :image)                      # GlyphInfo, font characters glyphs info


(Font :base-size :glyph-count* :glyph-padding :texture :recs :glyphs)         # Font, font texture and GlyphInfo array data


(Mesh :vertex-count* :triangle-count* :vertices :texcoords :texcoords2 :normals :tangents :colors :indices :anim-vertices :anim-normals :bone-ids :bone-weights :bone-matrices :bone-count* :vao-id* :vbo-id)  # Mesh, vertex data and vao/vbo


(Shader :id* :locs)                                                           # Shader


(MaterialMap :texture :color :value)                                          # MaterialMap


(Material :shader :maps :params)                                              # Material, includes shader and maps


(Model :transform :mesh-count* :material-count* :meshes :materials :mesh-material :bone-count* :bones :bind-pose)  # Model, meshes, materials and animation data


(ModelAnimation :bone-count* :frame-count* :bones :frame-poses :name)         # ModelAnimation


(Wave :frame-count* :sample-rate* :sample-size* :channels* :data)             # Wave, audio wave data


(AudioStream :sample-rate* :sample-size* :channels*)                          # AudioStream, custom audio stream


(Sound :stream :frame-count*)                                                 # Sound


(Music :stream :frame-count* :looping :ctx-type*)                             # Music, audio stream, anything longer than ~10 seconds should be streamed


(FilePathList :capacity* :count* :paths)                                      # File path list


(AutomationEventList :capacity* :count* :events)                              # Automation event list


(rlRenderBatch :buffer-count* :current-buffer* :draw-counter* :current-depth*)  # rlRenderBatch type
